patterns.note: Two distinct sticky navigation bars are used: a primary global navigation and a secondary page-specific navigation, both fixing to the top of the viewport upon scroll.
A prominent gradient from deep blue to teal is used as a large, abstract graphic element in the hero section and subtly repeated in the sticky sub-navigation bar.
A dedicated 'Total Cost of Ownership Savings' section uses oversized, bold numbers on a dark background to highlight key financial metrics, creating a strong visual impact.
A persistent promotional popup with a countdown timer appears from the bottom right corner of the screen after the user scrolls past a certain depth.
Content sections consistently use a mix of full-width backgrounds and a contained maximum content width for text and structured elements like cards and grids.

technique_notes: The site employs a dual sticky navigation system where both the primary global header and a secondary page-specific navigation bar become fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down.
A promotional overlay featuring a countdown timer is triggered to appear from the bottom right of the screen once the user has scrolled past a predefined point on the page.
Visual separation between content blocks is achieved by alternating background colors across sections, using white, light grey, and a deep blue.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are significantly larger and bolder than body text, establishing a clear visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller uppercase labels for emphasis.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 4-8px) are consistently applied to buttons, cards, and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical padding between main sections and comfortable spacing within content blocks, contributing to an airy feel.

standout: The design effectively uses a dual sticky navigation system, with a global header and a page-specific sub-navigation, to maintain context and ease of access. The prominent 'Total Cost of Ownership' section with its large, impactful numbers on a dark background is a distinctive way to present value propositions.
